source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 11 (PDF 244-272), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Hydrocarbons) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are hydrocarbons? Where are they found and what are they used for?
(Hydrocarbons kya hain? Yeh kahan milte hain aur kis kaam aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke organic compounds hain. Yeh petroleum aur natural gas mein bohat milte hain aur ghar aur industry mein fuel (eendhan) hain; medicines, plastics, perfumes aur polymers inhi se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: They are frequently used as domestic and industrial fuels.

blocks.prompt:
2 Classify aliphatic hydrocarbons into their families, stating whether each is cyclic or acyclic, saturated or unsaturated.
(Aliphatic hydrocarbons ki families batayein aur har aik ke baare mein likhein ke cyclic hai ya acyclic, saturated ya unsaturated.)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes: acyclic (bina halqa), saturated. Cycloalkanes: cyclic (halqa-daar), saturated. Alkenes aur alkynes: acyclic, unsaturated. Sab aliphatic hain, yani aromatic nahi.

book_ref.quote: Alkanes are acyclic aliphatic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
3 Why are aromatic compounds called 'aromatic'? Name two derivatives of benzene.
(Aromatic compounds ko 'aromatic' kyun kaha jata hai? Benzene ke do derivatives ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh lafz Greek 'aroma' (khushbu-daar) se bana kyun ke in compounds ki khaas boo hoti hai. Benzene (C₆H₆) bunyaadi aromatic compound hai; toluene aur phenol is ke derivatives hain.

book_ref.quote: The term aromatic was derived from the Greek word

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the general formula of alkanes and use it to write the molecular formulae of alkanes with 9 and 16 carbon atoms.
(Alkanes ka general formula likhein aur is se 9 aur 16 carbon wale alkanes ke molecular formule likhein.)
blocks.explanation: General formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂. n = 9: H = 2(9) + 2 = 20, C₉H₂₀ (nonane). n = 16: H = 2(16) + 2 = 34, C₁₆H₃₄.

book_ref.quote: Methane (CH₄) is the simplest member of this family.

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the molecular formula and the condensed structural formula of heptane.
(Heptane ka molecular formula aur condensed structural formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ mein n = 7 se heptane C₇H₁₆ hai. Condensed structure: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃ (do CH₃ siron ke darmiyan paanch CH₂).

book_ref.quote: By CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ heptane is C₇H₁₆

blocks.prompt:
6 What is an alkyl group? How is it named? Give two examples with abbreviations.
(Alkyl group kya hai? Is ka naam kaise rakha jata hai? Do misalein abbreviations ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Alkane se aik hydrogen atom hatane par jo bachta hai woh alkyl group hai. Is ka naam alkane ke -ane ko -yl se badal kar rakha jata hai. Misalein: methane se CH₃– methyl (Me–); ethane se CH₃CH₂– ethyl (Et–).

book_ref.quote: What we obtain after the removal of one hydrogen atom from an alkane is called an alkyl group.

blocks.prompt:
7 Write the structures and IUPAC names of the four butyl groups.
(Chaar butyl groups ki structures aur IUPAC naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: n-Butyl CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂– (butyl); sec-butyl CH₃CH₂CH(–)CH₃ (1-methylpropyl); isobutyl CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂– (2-methylpropyl); tert-butyl (CH₃)₃C– (1,1-dimethylethyl).

book_ref.quote: Table 11.3 alkyl groups, straight chain and branched and their names

blocks.prompt:
8 How is the parent chain of a branched alkane selected and numbered?
(Branched alkane ki parent chain kaise chuni aur number ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon atoms ki sab se lambi musalsal chain chunein (chahe formula mein mudi hui ho); yeh parent name deti hai. Is chain ki numbering us sire se karein jo substituent ke qareeb ho.

book_ref.quote: Number the longest chain beginning from the end nearest to the substituent.

blocks.prompt:
9 Give the IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃ and state the rule used for identical substituents.
(CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃ ka IUPAC naam likhein aur aik jaise substituents ka rule batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Lambi chain 6 carbon (hexane); methyl groups C-3 aur C-4 par: 3,4-dimethylhexane. Aik jaise substituents di, tri, tetra se dikhaye jate hain aur har aik ka apna number hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Then make certain that each and every substituent has a number.

blocks.prompt:
10 In the name 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane, why is ethyl written before methyl?
(4-ethyl-2-methylhexane ke naam mein ethyl, methyl se pehle kyun likha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substituents alphabetical tarteeb mein likhe jate hain, is liye ethyl (e) methyl (m) se pehle aata hai, number chahe kuch bhi hon. Alphabetical tarteeb mein di aur tri jaise prefixes nazar-andaz hote hain.

book_ref.quote: For example, we designate the following compound as 4-Ethyl-2-methylhexane.

blocks.prompt:
11 State the rule used when branching first occurs at an equal distance from either end of the longest chain. Give an example.
(Jab lambi chain ke dono siron se barabar faasle par branching ho to kaun sa rule lagta hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh naam chunein jo pehle farq wali jagah par chhota number de. Misaal: aik hexane jis ke methyls aik sire se 2,3,5 aur doosre se 2,4,5 hain, 2,3,5-trimethylhexane hai (3, 4 se chhota).

book_ref.quote: choose the name that gives the lower number at the first point of difference.

blocks.prompt:
12 How are cycloalkanes named? Name the cycloalkanes with three and four ring carbons and write their formulae.
(Cycloalkanes ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain? Teen aur chaar ring carbon wale cycloalkanes ke naam aur formule likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Utne hi carbon wale alkane ke naam se pehle cyclo lagaya jata hai. Teen ring carbon: cyclopropane, C₃H₆; chaar: cyclobutane, C₄H₈ (cycloalkanes CₙH₂ₙ hain).

book_ref.quote: Cycloalkanes are named by attaching the prefix

blocks.prompt:
13 Why do alkane molecules have a tetrahedral shape around each carbon atom?
(Alkane molecules mein har carbon ke gird shakal tetrahedral kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon ke chaar sp³ hybrid orbitals chaar single (σ) bonds banate hain. Chaar bonding pairs aik doosre ko barabar dafa karte hain aur tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hote hain, bond angle 109.5°.

book_ref.quote: Alkane molecules have a tetrahedral shape around carbon atoms.

blocks.prompt:
14 State the hybridization, type of bonds, bond angle and C–C bond length in ethane.
(Ethane mein hybridization, bonds ki qisam, bond angle aur C–C bond length batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon sp³ hybridized hai aur carbon aur hydrogen se sirf σ bonds banata hai. Bond angle 109.5° aur C–C bond length 1.54 Å hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbon atoms in alkane molecules form sigma bonds with surrounding carbon and hydrogen atoms.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why are cycloalkanes called saturated? Write the formula of cyclopentane.
(Cycloalkanes ko saturated kyun kehte hain? Cyclopentane ka formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cycloalkanes mein ring ke saare carbon atoms sirf single bonds se jure hain, is liye saturated hain. Yeh CₙH₂ₙ follow karte hain; cyclopentane (paanch ring carbon) C₅H₁₀ hai.

book_ref.quote: Cycloalkanes are also saturated, meaning that all of the carbons atoms that make up the ring are singly bonded to other atoms.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the physical states of alkanes at room temperature with respect to the number of carbon atoms.
(Room temperature par alkanes ki physical haalat carbon atoms ki tadaad ke lihaaz se bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar carbon tak (C₁ se C₄): be-rang, be-boo gases. Pentane se heptadecane (C₅ se C₁₇): be-rang, be-boo liquids. C₁₈ se aage: be-rang, be-boo waxy (mom jaise) solids.

book_ref.quote: Alkanes containing upto four carbon atoms are colourless, odourless, gases

blocks.prompt:
17 Why are alkanes insoluble in water but soluble in benzene?
(Alkanes water mein na-hal aur benzene mein hal kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes non-polar ya bohat halke polar hain. Is liye water jaise polar solvents mein hal nahi hote, magar hexane, benzene aur ether jaise non-polar solvents mein hal ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: insoluble in polar solvents like water, but soluble in non-polar solvents

blocks.prompt:
18 Which has the higher boiling point, butane or its isomer 2-methylpropane? Give the values.
(Butane aur is ke isomer 2-methylpropane mein kis ka boiling point ziyada hai? Qeematein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Butane (seedhi chain) ka boiling point ziyada hai, -0.50 °C; 2-methylpropane (isobutane, branched) -11.7 °C par ubalta hai. Branched alkanes apne seedhi chain wale isomers se kam par ubalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The boiling points of alkanes having branched chain structures are lower than their isomeric normal chain alkanes

blocks.text: 11.3 Reaction mechanism and modes of bond breaking

blocks.prompt:
19 What is meant by reaction mechanism? In how many ways can a covalent bond break?
(Reaction mechanism se kya muraad hai? Covalent bond kitne tareeqon se toot sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction mechanism woh qadmon ka silsila hai jo poore reaction ke dauran hote hain. Organic reactions mein bonds tootte hain; covalent bond do tareeqon se toot-ta hai: homolytic aur heterolytic fission.

book_ref.quote: Reaction mechanism is the series of steps that take place in the course of the overall reaction.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is a free radical? Why are free radicals extremely reactive?
(Free radical kya hai? Free radicals bohat ziyada reactive kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Free radical aisi species hai jis mein aik unpaired (akela) electron ho; yeh homolytic fission se banta hai. Yeh bohat reactive hai kyun ke unpaired electron jora banana chahta hai.

book_ref.quote: Free radicals are extremely reactive because of the tendency of unpaired electrons to become paired.

blocks.prompt:
21 Show the homolytic fission of a chlorine molecule. What is formed?
(Chlorine molecule ka homolytic fission dikhayein. Kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cl–Cl → Cl• + Cl•. Covalent bond barabar toot-ta hai, har atom shared pair ka aik electron leta hai, is liye do chlorine free radicals bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Figure 11.5: Homolytic fission and free radical formation

blocks.prompt:
22 Show the heterolytic fission of the C–Cl bond of a chloroalkane. How is it shown in mechanisms?
(Chloroalkane ke C–Cl bond ka heterolytic fission dikhayein. Mechanisms mein ise kaise dikhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: R₃C–Cl → R₃C⁺ + Cl⁻. Shared pair sirf chlorine leta hai, carbocation aur chloride ion (mukhalif charge wale ions) bante hain. Ise poore curly arrow se dikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Figure 11.6: Heterolytic fission and formation of ions

blocks.text: 11.4 Unreactive nature of alkanes towards polar reagents

blocks.prompt:
23 Why are alkanes called paraffins?
(Alkanes ko paraffins kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paraffin Latin parum = thora aur affinis = affinity (lagao) se bana. Alkanes ka lagao (reactivity) kam hai: aam haalat mein yeh acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents se react nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: parum = little, affinis = affinity

blocks.prompt:
24 How does electronegativity explain the inertness of alkanes towards polar reagents?
(Electronegativity polar reagents ke saath alkanes ki be-amali (inertness) ki wazahat kaise karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: C = 2.5 aur H = 2.1 mein sirf 0.4 ka farq hai, is liye C–H aur C–C mein electrons taqreeban barabar share hote hain. Bonds non-polar hain, polar reagents ko hamle ke liye koi charged jagah nahi milti.

book_ref.quote: The electronegativity values of carbon (2.5) and hydrogen (2.1) do not differ appreciably

blocks.prompt:
25 How does the nature of the sigma bond make alkanes unreactive?
(Sigma bond ki fitrat alkanes ko be-amal kaise banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sigma bond mein electrons nuclei ke darmiyan mazbooti se pakre hote hain, is liye bond bohat mustahkam hai. Isse torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye, is liye alkanes sirf ziyada temperature ya khaas halaat mein react karte hain.

book_ref.quote: A lot of energy is required to break it.

blocks.prompt:
26 What harmful effects can the combustion of hydrocarbons have on the environment?
(Hydrocarbons ke jalne ke mahol par kya nuqsan-deh asraat ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jalne se CO₂ banti hai jo greenhouse gas hai aur mausami tabdeeli (climate change) barhati hai. Na-mukammal jalne se carbon monoxide (CO) aur bareek zarraat nikalte hain jin ke sehat aur mahol par sangeen asraat hain.

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbon combustion produces CO₂, a greenhouse gas contributing to climate change.

blocks.prompt:
27 Name the two types of reactions that alkanes undergo under high temperature or suitable conditions.
(Ziyada temperature ya munasib halaat mein alkanes kaun se do qisam ke reactions karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Thermal aur catalytic reactions, maslan combustion aur cracking. (2) Free radical substitution reactions, jin mein free radical mechanism se aik atom ya group doosre se badalta hai (maslan halogenation).

book_ref.quote: Under high temperature or suitable conditions, alkanes undergo two types of reactions.

blocks.prompt:
28 What is halogenation of alkanes? Under what conditions does it occur?
(Alkanes ki halogenation kya hai? Yeh kin halaat mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogenation mein alkane ke hydrogen atoms free radicals ke zariye halogen atoms se badalte hain. Alkanes sunlight ya UV light mein chlorine aur bromine se react karte hain; hydrogens aik ke baad aik badalte hain, aur had halogen ki miqdaar par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: An example is the substitution of a halogen atom with a hydrogen of an alkane, called halogenation.

blocks.prompt:
29 Give reasons: (i) fluorine is not used for direct halogenation of alkanes; (ii) iodine does not substitute alkanes directly.
(Wajah batayein: (i) alkanes ki halogenation ke liye fluorine istemal nahi hoti; (ii) iodine alkanes mein seedha substitution nahi karti.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Fluorine ka reaction bohat shiddat wala hai aur carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid ka mixture deta hai. (ii) Iodine ka reaction bohat aahista aur reversible hai. Reactivity: F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂.

book_ref.quote: Iodine does not substitute directly because the reaction is too slow and reversible.

blocks.prompt:
30 Write the initiation and propagation steps for the chlorination of ethane in UV light.
(UV light mein ethane ki chlorination ke initiation aur propagation steps likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Initiation: Cl–Cl → 2Cl• (UV light). Propagation: CH₃–CH₃ + Cl• → CH₃–CH₂• + HCl, phir CH₃–CH₂• + Cl–Cl → CH₃–CH₂Cl + Cl•. Naya Cl• chain ko aage barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Propagation step is the second step in the free radical substitution

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Propagation mein har qadam par aik radical khatam aur aik naya radical paida hota hai; is liye reaction zanjeer (chain) ki tarah chalta rehta hai jab tak termination na ho.

blocks.prompt:
31 Write the three ways in which the termination step can occur in the chlorination of methane.
(Methane ki chlorination mein termination step ke teen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) •CH₃ + Cl• → CH₃Cl (chloroalkane). (ii) Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂. (iii) •CH₃ + •CH₃ → CH₃–CH₃ (dugne carbon wala alkane, thori miqdaar mein). Har aik mein do free radicals milte hain.

book_ref.quote: The termination may take place in different ways.

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is the presence of traces of ethane in the chlorination of methane taken as evidence of the free radical mechanism?
(Methane ki chlorination mein ethane ke asraat ko free radical mechanism ka saboot kyun mana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethane (methane se dugne carbon) sirf tab banti hai jab do methyl free radicals termination mein milein. Yeh kam hota hai is liye ethane thori miqdaar mein milti hai, magar is ki maujoodgi saabit karti hai ke methyl radicals bane the.

book_ref.quote: This type of termination is rare and the alkanes with double carbon atoms are formed in traces.

blocks.prompt:
33 Write the successive substitution products of methane with excess chlorine, with their names.
(Ziyada chlorine ke saath methane ki silsilewaar substitution ke products naam ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₄ → CH₃Cl (chloromethane) → CH₂Cl₂ (dichloromethane) → CHCl₃ (trichloromethane, chloroform) → CCl₄ (tetrachloromethane, carbon tetrachloride); har qadam par HCl banta hai. Ziyada chlorine se ziyada chlorine wale products.

book_ref.quote: Successive substitution of chloromethane to tetrachloromethane

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is the use of haloalkanes as solvents in the laboratory strictly monitored?
(Laboratory mein haloalkanes ko solvents ke taur par istemal karne par sakht nigrani kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haloalkanes behosh karne wale aur zehreele hain; halogen atoms barhne se un ki behosh karne ki taqat barhti hai. Is liye lab mein un ke solvent ke taur par istemal par sakht nigrani hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Use of these as organic solvents in lab is strictly monitored due to their toxic nature.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why are alkenes called unsaturated hydrocarbons? Write the molecular formula of the alkene with six carbon atoms.
(Alkenes ko unsaturated hydrocarbons kyun kehte hain? Chhe carbon wale alkene ka molecular formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ke molecules mein carbon-carbon double bond hota hai aur in mein mutabiq saturated hydrocarbon se do hydrogen kam hote hain. Hexane C₆H₁₄ hai, is liye alkene C₆H₁₂ (hexene) hai.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes have two hydrogen atoms less than the corresponding saturated hydrocarbons.

blocks.prompt:
36 Give the IUPAC names of (i) CH₃–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (ii) (CH₃)₂CH–CH=CH₂.
(IUPAC naam likhein: (i) CH₃–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (ii) (CH₃)₂CH–CH=CH₂.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Saat carbon ki chain, double bond ke qareeb sire se numbering, double bond C-3 se: 3-heptene. (ii) C=C wali chaar carbon ki chain, CH₂= sire se numbering; CH₃ C-3 par: 3-methyl-1-butene.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC rules for naming alkenes are similar in many respects to those for naming alkanes.

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the structural formulae of (i) 3-methyl-1-pentene (ii) 2-methyl-1-butene.
(Structural formule likhein: (i) 3-methyl-1-pentene (ii) 2-methyl-1-butene.)
blocks.explanation: (i) CH₂=CH–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃. (ii) CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃. Dono mein C-1 aur C-2 double bond banate hain aur methyl group apne number wale carbon par hai.

book_ref.quote: Number the chain so as to include both carbon atoms of the double bond.

blocks.prompt:
38 What are elimination reactions? How are they used to prepare alkenes?
(Elimination reactions kya hain? Inhein alkenes banane ke liye kaise istemal kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Elimination reactions mein saturated compound ke saath wale carbons se chhote atoms (H, OH, X) nikalte hain, yani H₂O ya HCl jaisa chhota molecule nikalta hai aur C=C double bond banta hai. Ethene isi tarah ethanol aur ethyl bromide se banti hai.

book_ref.quote: In such reactions, a small molecule such as H₂O or HCl, is removed from adjacent carbons in an organic molecule.

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the two steps of the preparation of ethene from ethanol and concentrated H₂SO₄.
(Ethanol aur concentrated H₂SO₄ se ethene banane ke do qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1: CH₃–CH₂OH + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–OSO₃H (ethyl hydrogen sulphate) + H₂O (180°C). Qadam 2: CH₃–CH₂OSO₃H → H₂C=CH₂ + H₂SO₄ (garam karne par).

book_ref.quote: In the first step, ethyl hydrogen sulphate is formed which decomposes on heating to produce ethene.

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between dehydration of alcohols and dehydrohalogenation of alkyl halides.
(Alcohols ki dehydration aur alkyl halides ki dehydrohalogenation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono elimination reactions hain jo alkenes dete hain; shuru ka compound, reagent aur nikalne wala molecule mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction involves the removal of a water molecule from the alcohol molecule.

rows: Alcohol se shuru, maslan ethanol.
Alkyl halide se shuru, maslan ethyl bromide.
Reagent: ziyada concentrated H₂SO₄, 180°C.
Reagent: alcoholic KOH, garam kar ke.
Water ka molecule nikalta hai.
Hydrogen aur halogen (KBr + H₂O ki surat) nikalte hain.
CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O
H₃C–CH₂–Br + KOH → H₂C=CH₂ + KBr + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
41 Write any four physical properties of alkenes.
(Alkenes ki koi chaar physical khasusiyat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Ethene, propene aur butene gases; C₅ se C₁₅ liquids; is se oopar solids. (2) Water mein na-hal, alcohol mein hal. (3) Khaas boo; roshan shole se jalte hain. (4) Alkanes ke bar-aks sp² hybridization ki wajah se halke polar.

book_ref.quote: First three members i.e. ethene, propene and butene are gases at room temperature

blocks.prompt:
42 Describe the hybridization of each carbon atom in ethene.
(Ethene ke har carbon atom ki hybridization bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon apna 2s orbital do 2p orbitals se mila kar teen barabar sp² hybrid orbitals banata hai jo aik plane mein hain. Aik unhybrid p-orbital bachta hai jo us plane par amoodan (90°) hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethene (C₂H₄) is the simplest alkene.

blocks.prompt:
43 How is the π bond formed in ethene?
(Ethene mein π bond kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono carbons ke unhybrid p-orbitals aik doosre ke parallel hain aur pehlu se (laterally) overlap karte hain. Is overlap se doosra carbon-carbon bond, π bond, σ bonds ke plane ke oopar aur neeche banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The unhybrid p-orbitals of each carbon atom which are parallel to each other overlap laterally to form another carbon-carbon bond.

blocks.prompt:
44 Why is the ethene molecule planar?
(Ethene molecule planar (hamwaar) kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: sp² hybridization se har carbon ke gird trigonal planar tarteeb aur taqreeban 120° angles bante hain. Double bond ke do carbon aur un se jure chaar atoms aik hi plane mein hain.

book_ref.quote: The sp² hybridization results in a trigonal planar arrangement around each carbon atom.

blocks.prompt:
45 Differentiate between a σ bond and a π bond.
(σ bond aur π bond mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: σ bond seedhi overlap se banta hai aur mazboot hai; π bond pehlu ki overlap se banta hai aur kamzor hai.

book_ref.quote: A π bond is, therefore, a weak bond as compared to a σ-bond.

rows: Seedhi (linear) overlap se, maslan sp² orbitals ki.
Parallel unhybrid p-orbitals ki lateral (pehlu) overlap se.
Electrons dono nuclei ko milane wali line par.
Electrons nuclei ki line se door.
Electrons mazbooti se pakre; mazboot bond.
Electrons kam mazbooti se pakre; kamzor bond, asaani se toot-ta hai.
Alkanes aur alkenes dono mein.
Alkenes mein (C=C ka doosra bond).

blocks.prompt:
46 Why are alkenes more reactive than alkanes?
(Alkenes, alkanes se ziyada reactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes mein double bond hai jis mein π bond hota hai. π electrons nuclei ki line se door, kam mazbooti se pakre aur asaani se toot-te hain; yeh electrophiles ke hamle ke liye khule bhi hain, is liye alkenes asaani se electrophilic addition karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes are more reactive than alkanes due to the presence of the double bond.

blocks.prompt:
47 Why do alkenes act as nucleophiles?
(Alkenes nucleophile ka kaam kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleophile (Nu:⁻) electrons ka jora deta hai. Alkenes ke paas dheele pakre π electrons hain jo woh electrophile (E⁺) ko de sakte hain, is liye woh nucleophile hain.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes act as nucleophile because they contains pi electrons.

blocks.prompt:
48 What is the role of ethene in the ripening of fruits?
(Phalon ko pakane mein ethene ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paude ethene ko qudrati ripening hormone ke taur par banate hain. Asaan katai aur transport ke liye phal aur sabziyan kachchi tori jati hain aur ethene mein rakhi jati hain taake jaldi pak jayein.

book_ref.quote: fruits and vegetables are often picked unripe

blocks.prompt:
49 What is a carbocation? Classify CH₃CH₂⁺, (CH₃)₂CH⁺ and (CH₃)₃C⁺.
(Carbocation kya hai? CH₃CH₂⁺, (CH₃)₂CH⁺ aur (CH₃)₃C⁺ ki darja-bandi karein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbocation aisa alkyl group hai jis ke aik carbon par aik positive charge ho. CH₃CH₂⁺: primary (1°), aik carbon se jura; (CH₃)₂CH⁺: secondary (2°), do carbon; (CH₃)₃C⁺: tertiary (3°), teen carbon.

book_ref.quote: Carbocations are classified into following types.

blocks.prompt:
50 Arrange CH₃⁺, CH₃CH₂⁺, (CH₃)₂CH⁺ and (CH₃)₃C⁺ in increasing order of stability.
(CH₃⁺, CH₃CH₂⁺, (CH₃)₂CH⁺ aur (CH₃)₃C⁺ ko stability ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃⁺ < CH₃CH₂⁺ < (CH₃)₂CH⁺ < (CH₃)₃C⁺. Positive carbon par electron dene wale (+I) alkyl groups jitne ziyada, stability utni ziyada; is liye tertiary sab se mustahkam.

book_ref.quote: This means that tertiary carbocation is the most stable

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between the positive (+I) and negative (-I) inductive effects.
(Positive (+I) aur negative (-I) inductive effect mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono σ bond ko polarize karte hain; +I groups electrons dete hain, -I groups khainchte hain.

book_ref.quote: Electron donating species, are said to have positive inductive effect(+I)

rows: Electron dene wale groups dikhate hain.
Electron khainchne wale groups dikhate hain.
Misaal: alkyl groups.

Mustaqil dipole banata hai, halogen negative.

blocks.prompt:
52 Why is a carbocation an electrophile?
(Carbocation electrophile kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbocation ke carbon par positive charge hai, is liye woh electron pair lene wala (electrophile) hai. Yeh nucleophile, maslan Br⁻, se react karta hai jo use electron pair deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the positive charge on the carbon atom, carbocation is electrophile.

blocks.prompt:
53 Explain the -I effect of chlorine in a chloroalkane C₂–C₁–Cl.
(Chloroalkane C₂–C₁–Cl mein chlorine ke -I effect ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chlorine bonded electrons apni taraf khainchta hai, is liye juzwi negative aur C₁ juzwi positive (δ⁺) ho jata hai. Yeh asar chain mein aage jata hai, C₂ par kam positive charge (δδ⁺). Mustaqil dipole banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Electron withdrawing groups, such as a halogen atom, have a negative inductive effect (-I).

blocks.prompt:
54 What is electrophilic addition? Outline its general mechanism.
(Electrophilic addition kya hai? Is ka aam mechanism mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Alkene ke double bond par electrophile ka jurna electrophilic addition hai. Electrons se bhara C=C electrophile X⁺ par hamla karta hai aur carbocation intermediate banta hai; phir nucleophile Y⁻ carbocation par hamla kar ke addition product deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes reacts with an electrophile to give a carbocation intermediate that then reacts with a nucleophile.

blocks.prompt:
55 How is the unsaturation of an organic compound tested with bromine? Give the equation with ethene.
(Bromine se organic compound ki unsaturation ka test kaise kiya jata hai? Ethene ke saath equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bromine (surkhi-maail bhoora) carbon tetrachloride jaise inert solvent mein compound mein dala jata hai; unsaturated compound foran rang khatam kar deta hai. CH₂=CH₂ + Br₂ → Br–CH₂–CH₂–Br.

book_ref.quote: Halogenation means addition of halogens like chlorine or bromine.

blocks.prompt:
56 Br₂ is non-polar. How does it act as an electrophile towards an alkene?
(Br₂ non-polar hai. Yeh alkene ke liye electrophile kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab Br₂ C=C ke qareeb aata hai to double bond ki ziyada electron density Br–Br ke electron pair ko qareeb wale Br se door dhakelti hai. Woh Br juzwi positive (δ⁺) ho kar electrophile ban jata hai aur π electrons ka jora leta hai.

book_ref.quote: Bromine (Br₂) is a non-polar molecule

blocks.prompt:
57 Write the steps of the mechanism of addition of HBr to ethene.
(Ethene par HBr ke addition ke mechanism ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1: nucleophilic π bond H–Br ke H par hamla karta hai; HBr se Br⁻ banta hai aur ethene carbocation CH₃–CH₂⁺ ban jati hai. Qadam 2: Br⁻ (nucleophile) carbocation par hamla karta hai: CH₃–CH₂–Br (bromoethane).

book_ref.quote: Nucleophilic pi-bond attacks the hydrogen in hydrogen halide.

blocks.prompt:
58 State Markovnikov's rule and predict the main product of adding HBr to 2-methylpropene, (CH₃)₂C=CH₂.
(Markovnikov's rule bayan karein aur 2-methylpropene, (CH₃)₂C=CH₂, par HBr ke addition ka main product batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Rule: jab polar reagent unsymmetrical alkene par jurta hai to us ka negative hissa kam hydrogen wale double-bond carbon par jurta hai. H CH₂ par jurta hai, 3° carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺ banta hai; phir Br⁻ se (CH₃)₃C–Br, 2-bromo-2-methylpropane.

book_ref.quote: When a polar reagent adds to an unsymmetrical alkene

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan H ziyada hydrogen wale carbon (CH₂) par jurta hai taake positive charge us carbon par aaye jis par teen CH₃ groups hain; teen +I groups us tertiary carbocation ko sab se mustahkam banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
59 Arrange HF, HCl, HBr and HI in the order of their rate of addition to alkenes. On what does the product depend?
(HF, HCl, HBr aur HI ko alkenes par addition ke rate ki tarteeb mein likhein. Product kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rate: HF < HCl < HBr < HI (rate HF se HI ki taraf barhta hai). Sab C=C par aik hi tarah jurte hain; product is par munhasir hai ke alkene symmetrical hai (aik product) ya unsymmetrical (do mumkin products).

book_ref.quote: All hydrogen halides (HBr,HCl,HI,HF) give this reaction

blocks.prompt:
60 What is hydrogenation? Give its conditions and its industrial use.
(Hydrogenation kya hai? Is ke halaat aur industrial istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogenation alkene par Ni/Pt catalyst ke saath 250-300 °C par molecular hydrogen jorna hai jis se saturated compound banta hai: H₂C=CH₂ + H₂ → H₃C–CH₃. Industry mein is se vegetable oil margarine (Banaspati ghee) banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrogenation means addition of molecular hydrogen to an alkene

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between hydrogenation and hydration of ethene.
(Ethene ki hydrogenation aur hydration mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogenation H₂ jorti hai aur alkane deti hai; hydration H₂O jorti hai aur alcohol deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Similar to hydrohalogenation, the alkene forms a carbocation intermediate

Carbocation ke zariye, hydrohalogenation ki tarah.

blocks.prompt:
62 What is halohydration? Write the equation for ethene with bromine water and name the product.
(Halohydration kya hai? Ethene aur bromine water ki equation likhein aur product ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Halohydration mein alkene water ki maujoodgi mein halogen se react kar ke halohydrin banati hai. H₂C=CH₂ + Br₂ + H₂O → Br–CH₂–CH₂–OH + HBr; product 2-bromoethanol (ethylene bromohydrin) hai.

book_ref.quote: Br and OH add to the two carbons of the double bond

blocks.prompt:
63 What is an epoxide? How is ethylene oxide obtained from ethene and what does its acid hydrolysis give?
(Epoxide kya hai? Ethene se ethylene oxide kaise milta hai aur is ki acid hydrolysis se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epoxide oxygen wala teen-rukni cyclic ether hai jo alkene ki epoxidation se banta hai. Ethene molecular oxygen aur transition metal catalyst se ethylene oxide banti hai. Acid hydrolysis se epoxide diol ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Ethene can also be converted to ethylene oxide using molecular oxygen and metal catalysts.

blocks.prompt:
64 What is ozonolysis? Write the equation for ethene and state one use of the reaction.
(Ozonolysis kya hai? Ethene ki equation likhein aur is reaction ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ozonolysis ozone (O₃) se alkenes ka oxidation se tootna hai: alkene ozonide banati hai jo reduce ho kar carbonyl compounds deta hai. C₂H₄ + O₃ → C₂H₄O₃ →(Zn/H₂O) 2CH₂O. Is se na-maloom alkenes ki banawat pehchani jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes react with ozone (O₃) to form ozonides

blocks.prompt:

(Monomer aur polymer mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Monomers chhote reactive molecules hain; polymers un se bane bohat lambe molecules hain.

book_ref.quote: Polymerization is the formation of extremely long molecules (polymers) from small reactive molecules that join together (monomers).

66 What is a repeating unit? Write the equation for the polymerization of chloroethene showing the repeating unit.
(Repeating unit kya hai? Chloroethene ki polymerization ki equation repeating unit ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Repeating unit atoms ka sab se chhota group hai jo aik ke baad aik jur kar polymer chain banata hai; ise square brackets mein dikhaya jata hai. n CH₂=CHCl → [–CH₂–CHCl–]ₙ (PVC); monomer ka C=C, C–C single bond ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A repeating unit is the smallest group of atoms that when connected one after the other make up the polymer chain.

blocks.prompt:
67 Name two conjugated dienes and write their structures.
(Do conjugated dienes ke naam aur structures likhein.)
blocks.explanation: But-1,3-diene: CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂. 2-Methylbut-1,3-diene (isoprene): CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂. Dono mein do C=C ke darmiyan aik single bond hai.

book_ref.quote: As the name indicates, a diene is a molecule containing two double bonds between carbon atoms.

blocks.prompt:
68 Is CH₂=CH–CH₂–CH=CH₂ a conjugated diene? Give a reason.
(Kya CH₂=CH–CH₂–CH=CH₂ conjugated diene hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Conjugated diene mein double bonds ke darmiyan aik single bond hota hai. Yahan darmiyan CH₂ group hai, yani do single bonds, is liye un ke p-orbitals poore system par overlap nahi kar sakte.

book_ref.quote: In a Conjugated diene, the double bonds in the carbon chain are separated by a single bond.

blocks.prompt:
69 Give one industrial use of 1,3-butadiene and explain why it is suitable.
(1,3-butadiene ka aik industrial istemal batayein aur wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 1,3-Butadiene synthetic rubber banane mein istemal hota hai. Is ki conjugated banawat polymerization mumkin banati hai jis se lambi chains banti hain jo rubber jaisi khasusiyat dikhati hain.

book_ref.quote: The conjugated structure allows for polymerization, leading to long chains that exhibit rubber-like properties.

blocks.prompt:
70 Why is isomerism common in hydrocarbons with more than three carbon atoms? How many isomers does pentane have?
(Teen se ziyada carbon wale hydrocarbons mein isomerism aam kyun hai? Pentane ke kitne isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Teen se ziyada carbon hon to atoms ko tamam valencies poori karte hue aik se ziyada tareeqon se joda ja sakta hai, is liye aik formula ki kai banawatein hoti hain. Carbon barhne se isomers tezi se barhte hain; pentane ke teen hain.

book_ref.quote: Isomerism is not only possible but common if the compound contains more than three carbon atoms.

blocks.prompt:

(Butane (C₄H₁₀) ke chain isomers naam ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (butane, seedhi chain) aur CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₃ (2-methylpropane, isobutane, branched). In ki carbon chain ki noiyat mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: for pentane (C₅H₁₂) and butane (C₄H₁₀), the following arrangements are possible.

blocks.explanation: Aik hi molecular formula magar mukhtalif functional groups wale compounds functional group isomerism dikhate hain. Misaal: C₂H₆O ethanol, CH₃CH₂OH (alcohol), aur methoxymethane, CH₃–O–CH₃ (ether).

book_ref.quote: The compounds having the same molecular formula but different functional groups are said to exhibit functional group isomerism.

blocks.prompt:
74 What is metamerism? Give an example of a pair of ethers that are metamers.
(Metamerism kya hai? Metamers ethers ke aik jode ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Metamerism functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem se hota hai; metamers aik hi homologous series ke hote hain. Misaal: ethoxyethane CH₃CH₂–O–CH₂CH₃ aur methoxypropane CH₃–O–CH₂CH₂CH₃, dono C₄H₁₀O.

book_ref.quote: unequal distribution of carbon atoms on either side of the functional group

blocks.prompt:
75 What is tautomerism? Give the example described in the chapter.
(Tautomerism kya hai? Chapter mein di gayi misaal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Tautomerism aik hi molecule mein proton ke aik atom se doosre par jaane se hota hai. Amino acids zwitterions ki surat mein hote hain jo carboxylic acid wale sire se proton ke amine group par jaane se bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
78 Write the balanced equation for the complete combustion of ethane. Why is it an organic oxidation?
(Ethane ke mukammal jalne ki balanced equation likhein. Yeh organic oxidation kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2C₂H₆ + 7O₂ → 4CO₂ + 6H₂O (ya C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O). Jaanch: C 4 = 4, H 12 = 12, O 14 = 8 + 6. Carbon aur hydrogen par oxygen jurti hai, is liye oxidation hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxidation of organic compounds involving reaction with oxygen is usually the combustion reaction:

blocks.prompt:
79 Name three reducing agents used in organic synthesis and write the reduction of ethanal.
(Organic synthesis mein istemal hone wale teen reducing agents ke naam likhein aur ethanal ki reduction likhein.)
blocks.explanation: LiAlH₄, NaBH₄ aur Sn + conc. HCl. LiAlH₄ ke saath garam kar ke: CH₃–CHO + 2[H] → CH₃–CH₂–OH (ethanal se ethanol); hydrogen jurti hai, is liye reduction hai.

book_ref.quote: Various reducing agents are used in Organic synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
80 Write the equation for the oxidation of ethanol by acidified K₂Cr₂O₇. Why is it called oxidation?
(Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se ethanol ki oxidation ki equation likhein. Ise oxidation kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: C₂H₅OH + 2[O] → CH₃COOH + H₂O. Primary alcohol carboxylic acid (ethanoic acid) ban jata hai; oxygen jurti aur hydrogen nikalti hai, is liye oxidation hai.

book_ref.quote: Reaction of primary alcohols with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ to make carboxylic acids

blocks.prompt:
81 Why is the epoxidation of an alkene classed as an oxidation reaction?
(Alkene ki epoxidation ko oxidation reaction kyun shumaar kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epoxidation mein alkene ke C=C par aik oxygen atom jurta hai aur teen-rukni cyclic ether (epoxide) banta hai. Oxygen ka jurna organic oxidation hai; molecular oxygen aur metal catalysts jaise oxidizing agents istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The epoxidation of alkene is also example of oxidation reaction.
